purpose: Measure the real CPU NumPy merge plus atomic global commit path at the two exact failed-run fragment sizes before one five-node retry.

thresholds.derivation: The required throughput factor is 59/46. The failed mean update latency 1.739070100338624 divided by that factor is 1.35588516298 seconds; the 1.355-second ceiling adds a small margin and is applied directly to each real NumPy merge plus commit measurement.

next_gate: A pass authorizes one five-node capacity smoke under the user-approved lightweight S1-13 recovery process; no per-candidate Checker authorization or manually supplied file hash is required.
